_comment: "When this is put FACE UP INTO YOUR ARSENAL, it gets go again this turn." Nothing about this worked. The trigger was ON_ENTER_PLAY -- an arsenal is not the arena, so it never fired; ON_PUT_FACEUP_IN_ARSENAL is new because the nearest existing trigger, ON_PUT_FACEUP_FROM_DECK, requires the card to have come from the deck and this one does not care. Its condition was CARD_IN_ZONE zone:arsenal card:"swift_shot_red" -- 'card' is not a key CARD_IN_ZONE reads, so it asked only whether the arsenal was NON-EMPTY, which is true whenever this card is there and just as true when it is not; a restriction on THIS card is SELF_IN_ZONE. And GAIN keyword grants to the CURRENT COMBAT, of which there is none while a card sits in arsenal, so the go again went nowhere. Approximation stated rather than hidden: the grant is scoped to a card of this NAME played from arsenal this turn rather than to this exact object, because per-object turn-scoped keyword grants do not exist. The arsenal holds one card, so in practice the two coincide.
